findings.summary: Hardenberg: Former Greenland PM aide and energy exec, co-owner of Greenland Water Bank (sold stake to Lauder). Also partnering with ex-Trump staffer Drew Horn on 1.5GW AI data center via Inuit Development Company + AmForge Corporation.
findings.detail: Svend Hardenberg is a former top Greenland civil servant (prime ministerial aide, fired ~decade ago) and former head of national energy company. Currently Founder/CEO of Qappik ApS. Director at Greenland Minerals/Energy Transition Minerals (ETM:ASX). Co-owned Greenland Water Bank with Jorgen Waever Johansen; both sold partial stakes to Lauder consortium. Separately, Hardenberg owns Inuit Development Company which is partnering with AmForge Corporation (led by Drew Horn, ex-Trump admin: chief of staff Office of International Affairs at DOE, policy director for VP Pence) on plans for what they call world's largest AI data center in Kangerlussuaq, Greenland. Project: 300MW initially, scaling to 1.5GW by 2028. Powered by hydropower. Agreement signed in Kangerlussuaq. However, project has NOT secured land or approvals; Greenland's Department of Business has not engaged in dialogue with Horn or GreenMet. Hardenberg is a node connecting Lauder's investment consortium to the broader US-Greenland commercial push. Lead: 21192.

evidence.source_quote: Horn served as chief of staff for Office of International Affairs at US Department of Energy and as policy director for Vice President Mike Pence

findings.summary: Svend Hardenberg is co-owner of Greenland Water Bank ApS (with Johansen and GDP LLC). Also appointed director/General Manager of Greenland Minerals AS (ASX:ETM subsidiary) in late 2024/2025. Business partner of Drew Horn (GreenMet CEO, Trump-Pence admin alumnus) per LittleSis. Former Permanent Secretary of Greenland Premier's Office; former CEO of Nukissiorfiit (national energy company).

Svend Hardenberg is co-founder Greenland Invest ApS and former Permanent Secretary at Greenland Premier's Office. Current CEO Mannvit ApS. Business partners with Drew Horn (GreenMet CEO), who is former Trump/Pence national security staffer. Hardenberg and Horn are pursuing AI data center in Kangerlussuaq (Inuit Development Company / AmForge Corporation partnership). Hardenberg previously chaired Greenland Development A/S.

evidence.evidence_ref: LittleSis / ArcticToday Drew Horn article / greenlandinvest.com

findings.summary: GreenMet role in Hardenberg-AmForge AI data center deal is 'matchmaker/advisor' not formal co-venturer. Hardenberg's Inuit Development Company signed LOI with AmForge directly; GreenMet asked by Hardenberg to help find US partner. GreenMet continues as advisor for securing US government investment. Horn: 'He handles everything related to Greenland and Denmark, I handle everything related to the United States'

Hardenberg and Horn also partnered on a seaweed treatment project modeled on Royal Greenland's state-owned seaweed operation. This is separate from the AI data center deal and indicates a multi-project business partnership rather than a single-project relationship.

Hardenberg chairs ETM Greenland A/S and serves as General Manager Greenland for Energy Transition Minerals (ASX:ETM), appointed May 2025. ETM controls the Kvanefjeld REE+uranium deposit. This makes Hardenberg simultaneously: (1) co-owner Greenland Water Bank (Lauder consortium), (2) business partner Drew Horn/GreenMet on data center + seaweed ventures, (3) General Manager ETM's Greenland arm (separate REE deposit from Tanbreez). Hardenberg sits across multiple competing REE interests.

Hardenberg full company portfolio (Danish business registry ownr.dk): Direct ownership: GREENLAND INVEST ApS (CVR 12713460, 50-66.65% stake, Chair since 2015), Amaroq ApS (CVR 42270458, 100%, Chair since 2024), Qappik ApS (CVR 43890484, 100%, Founder/Director/Chair since 2023). Board roles: Greenland Minerals A/S (since Oct 2024), Greenland Water Bank ApS (since Jul 2025), ETM Greenland A/S (Chair, since May 2025), Nanoq Power ApS (Chair since Dec 2016), Imivik of Greenland ApS (Chair since Aug 2025), Inuit Development Company ApS (Chair since 2024). Director roles: Amaroq ApS, Inuit Development Company ApS, Qappik ApS. UK dissolved entity: Inuit Development Company London Ltd (13273140), director since Mar 2021.
